Appendix   3.1 Appendix 1: Travels supported by the International Vaccine Institute -­‐ Three round trips Seoul – Dhaka – Seoul and the accommodation fees have been supported by the International Vaccine Institute for the trial monitoring purpose and the visit of the plant of Incepta Pharmaceuticals in Bangladesh.  -­‐ One round trip Seoul – Accra  and Ouagadougou - Seoul and accommodation was supported the International Vaccine Institute to attend and facilitate the joint workshop co-organized by IVI, the University of Bielefeld and the University of Legon on the infectious diseases epidemiology at the University of Legon, Accra, Ghana. This trip gave me the opportunity to visit my family in Burkina four month after the start of the fellowship programme.   3.2 Appendix 2: Training fees supported by the International Vaccine Institute -­‐ My attendance to the International Vaccinology Course has been supported by IVI (Approximate cost = US $ 2,500).   3.3 Appendix 3: List of publications during the fellowship period -­‐ S.
